notes.title: Post Next Fest Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409380/44cbbf2c312c3c149caad244a96e3aa4bb866366.png[/img]

[h1]POST NEXT FEST UPDATE[/h1]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
- Die Slot sizes are increased.

- Dropping dice on die slots are made easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409380/d70aa7f43abe9394a2a238936326dd732f21bcaa.gif[/img]


[h3]Market Stage Update[/h3]
- Now you can see the dice requirements of die slots for cards before you buy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409380/145c09e87f92c2cd5832ed90096d0c7d63421936.gif[/img]


[h3]Card and Relic Bugs and Updates[/h3]
- Some bugs about cards and relics are fixed.

- Extra Damage Relic is updated. Now the bonus damage is added to each die you stack on Basit Attack card for the 'Warrior'.


[h3]Resolution Problems[/h3]
- We are aware of the problem causing UI to get positioned out of screen for some resolutions and we are working on the issue.

- We are working on making the game work good in 'Windowed Mode'.


[h3]Balancing[/h3]
- Your feedbacks about game's balance are noted. We are currently redesigning our demo level and early access dungeons will be handled with the same approach.


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
- We will add more cards relics and enemies.

- We will introduce a new playable character and Different Ultimate abilities for each character.

- We will improve our store page with better visuals and localization for more languages.
